A vampire may use this power to move clumps of 
skin, fat, and muscle tissue, thus providing additional 
padding where needed. For each success scored on a 
Dexterity + Medicine roll (difficulty 8), the vampire 
may increase the subject’s soak dice pool by one, at the 
expense of either a point of Strength or a health level 
(vampire’s choice).

powers.name: Bonecraft
powers.description:
This terrible power allows a vampire to manipulate 
bone in the same manner that flesh is shaped. In conjunction with Fleshcraft, above, this power enables a 
Vicissitude practitioner to deform a victim (or herself) 
beyond recognition. This power should be used in conjunction with the flesh-shaping arts, unless the vampire wants to inflict injury on the victim (see below).

System: The vampire’s player must spend a blood 
point and make a Strength + Medicine roll (difficulties 
as above). Bonecraft may be used without the fleshshaping arts, as an offensive weapon. Each success 
scored on the Strength + Medicine roll (difficulty 7) 
inflicts one health level of lethal damage on the victim, as his bones rip, puncture, and slice their way out 
of his skin.
The vampire may utilize this power (on herself or 
others) to form spikes or talons of bone, either on the 
knuckles as an offensive weapon or all over the body 
as defensive “quills.” If bone spikes are used, the vampire o

The vampire may utilize this power (on herself or 
others) to form spikes or talons of bone, either on the 
knuckles as an offensive weapon or all over the body 
as defensive “quills.” If bone spikes are used, the vampire or victim takes one health level of lethal damage 
(the vampire’s comes from having the very sharp bone 
pierce through his skin — this weaponry doesn’t come 
cheaply). In the case of quills, the subject takes a number of health levels equal to five minus the number of 
successes (a botch kills the subject or sends the vampire 
into torpor). These health levels may be healed normally. Knuckle spikes inflict Strength +1 lethal damage. Defensive quills inflict a hand-to-hand attacker’s 
Strength in lethal damage unless the attacker scores 
three or more successes on the attack roll (in which 
case the attacker takes no damage); the defender still 
takes damage normally. Quills also enable the vampire 
or altered subject to add two to all damage inflicted via 
holds, clinches, or tackles.
A vampire who scores five or more successes on the 
Strength + Medicine roll may cause a rival vampire’s 
rib cage to curve inward and pierce the heart. While 
this does not send a vampire into torpor, it does cause 
the affected vampire to lose half his blood points, as 
the seat of his vitae ruptures in a shower of gore.

powers.name: Horrid Form
powers.description:
Kindred use this power to become hideous and deadly monsters. The vampire’s stature increases to a full 
eight feet (two and a half meters), the skin becomes a 
sickly greenish-gray or grayish-black chitin, the arms 
become apelike and ropy with ragged black nails, and 
the face warps into something out of a nightmare. A 
row of spines sprouts from the vertebrae, and the external carapace exudes a foul-smelling grease.
System: The Horrid Form costs two blood points to 
awaken. All Physical Attributes increase by three, but 
all Social Attributes drop to zero, except when dealing 
with others also in Horrid Form. However, a vampire 
in Horrid Form who is trying to intimidate someone 
may substitute Strength for a Social Attribute. Damage inflicted in brawling combat increases by one due 
to the jagged ridges and bony knobs creasing the creature’s hands.

powers.name: Bloodform
powers.description:
A vampire with this power can physically transform 
all or part of her body into sentient vitae. This blood 
is in all respects identical to the vampire’s normal vitae; she can use it to nourish herself or others, create 
ghouls, or establish blood bonds. If all this blood is imbibed or otherwise destroyed, the vampire meets Final 
Death.
System: The vampire may transform all or part of 
herself as she deems fit. Each leg can turn into two 
blood points worth of vitae, as can the torso; each arm, 
the head, and the abdomen convert to one blood point 
each. The blood can be reconverted to the body part, 
provided it is in contact with the vampire. If the blood 
has been utilized or destroyed, the vampire must spend 
a number of blood points equal to what was originally 
created to regrow the missing body part.
A vampire entirely in this form may not be staked, 
cut, bludgeoned, or pierced, but can be burned or exposed to the sun. The vampire may ooze along, drip up 
walls, and flo

she were in Tenebrous Form (p. 190).
Mental Disciplines may be used, provided no eye 
contact or vocal utterance is necessary, although the 
vampire can perceive her surroundings just fine (but 
the perceptions are always centered on the largest pool 
of blood). If a vampire in this form “washes” over a 
mortal or animal, that mortal must make a Courage 
roll (difficulty 8) or fly into a panic.
••••• • Chiropteran Marauder
Similar to Horrid Form, the Chiropteran Marauder 
is a terrifying, bipedal bat, bearing a wickedly fanged 
maw and veined, leathery wings. This power confers all 
of the benefits of the Horrid Form, in addition to a few 
others. The mere sight of the marauder is enough to 
make mortals or weak-willed vampires flee in horror.
System: The vampire gains all the effects of the Horrid Form. Further, the Marauder’s fluted wings allow 
flight at 25 mph (40 kph), during which the vampire 
may carry, but not manipulate, objects no larger than 
it can hold in its hands. If the player chooses to, she 
may make a Strength + Medicine roll (difficulty 6) to 
extend bony claws at the ends of the vampire’s wings. 
These claws inflict Strength +2 aggravated damage. 
Also, the vampire subtracts two from all hearing-based

powers.name: Eyes of the Dead
powers.description:
The necromancer employing the Eyes of the Dead 
can see with the perceptions of the Restless Dead 
(called Deathsight). To such a manipulator of ghostly 
energies, the auras of surrounding beings give off telltale hints as to their health and even their ultimate 
fate; the necromancer can see the energies of death 
flowing through everyone, just as ghosts can. By looking at the entropic markings on a person’s body, the 
necromancer can gain rough knowledge of how far that 
person is from death, how soon that person is likely to 
die, and even what the cause of her death is likely to 

be. The information thus gained is not exact by any 
means, but it gives the necromancer an edge over those 
she scrutinizes.
System: The player rolls Perception + Occult, difficulty 6. One success lets a necromancer determine 
whether someone is injured, diseased, or dying, as well 
as whether the individual labors under any sort of curse 
or baleful magic. 
Further, the vampire can divine the targ
powers.system:
The player rolls Perception + Occult, difficulty 6. One success lets a necromancer determine 
whether someone is injured, diseased, or dying, as well 
as whether the individual labors under any sort of curse 
or baleful magic. 
Further, the vampire can divine the target’s eventual 
demise, depending on the successes scored. One success means the character can guess how long the target has to live to within a few weeks. Three successes 
means the character can estimate how long the target 
has to live and what the probable source of death will 
be, as the entropic markings show the wounds that will 
someday exist on that person. Five successes means the 
character can actually see where and when the event 
will occur by interpreting the black marks on the target’s soul. 
This ability lasts for one scene, though the necromancer may choose to end the power early. It can be 
used to read the fate of only one target at a time. Storytellers should exercise judgment with this power, since 
the markings of death are typically unavoidable. He 
may decide to roll the dice himself, so that the player 
has no way of knowing whether her insight is correct.

powers.name: Aura of Decay
powers.description:
The necromancer can strengthen the feeling of entropy around her to the point where it breaks down 
nonliving objects and machines. It can gnarl wood, 
rust metal, crack silicon chips, and erode plastic, glass, 
and dead organic material. This power has a range of 
one yard or meter from the necromancer’s body, but all 
those in the presence of the vampire can feel her corruption as an icy wind.
System: No roll is required, but this power does cost 
at least one blood point. Objects subjected to this Aura 
of Decay break down and become useless after being 
targeted. How the object gives out, as well as the exact 
mechanism of failure, is up to the Storyteller. Corrosion, metal fatigue, or sheer brittleness are all suitably 
likely for any given item’s demise, but the in-game effect of using a doomed item is as if the owning character rolled a botch. The speed at which an item breaks 
down depends on how many blood points are spent.

powers.name: Soul Feast
powers.description:
Just as the necromancer can release entropic energies from within, she may also pull them into herself 
as a source of power. Soul Feasting allows the caster 
to either draw on the ambient death energies around 
her or to actively feed on a ghost, stealing the wraith’s 
substance and mystically transforming that energy into 
sustenance.
System: The player spends one Willpower point to 
allow the vampire to feed on the negative energies of 
the dead. If the character is drawing the energies from 
the atmosphere, she must be in a place where death has 
occurred within the hour or in a place where death is 
common, such as a cemetery, a morgue, or the scene of 
a recent murder. Generally, the necromancer can draw 
anywhere from one to four points of entropy from such 
a location, although the difficulty in using all Necromancy and similar deathly powers within the area 
increases by an equal amount for a number of nights 
equal to the points taken. The energies of such an area 
may on

In cases when the necromancer feeds on a ghost, the 
vampire must actually attack the wraith as if feeding 
normally. Wraiths have up to 10 “blood points” that 
may be taken from them, and they become less and 
less substantial as their spirit essence drains away. The 
character is vulnerable to any attack the ghost might 
make, even those that do not normally affect the physical world; while feeding, the vampire is essentially in 
a half-state, existing in both the living lands and the 
Underworld simultaneously. The wraith so attacked is 
considered immobilized and cannot run or escape unless it can defeat the vampire in a resisted Willpower 
roll (difficulty 6 for both sides). This power may also 
be used in conjunction with Ash Path Necromancy, 
allowing the vampire to drain power (though not sustenance) from ghosts while traveling in the lands of 
the dead.

powers.name: Breath of Thanatos
powers.description:
The Breath of Thanatos allows the necromancer to 
draw out entropic energy and focus it upon an area 
or person by taking a deep breath and then forcefully 
exhaling a fog of necromantic energy. This cloud of 
virulence is completely invisible to anyone without the 
ability to see the passing of entropy. The energy of this 
cloud is like a beacon for Spectres, and they are drawn 
to the entropic force like moths to a flame.
Once the energy is pulled from the necromancer’s 
body, she can either disperse it over a large area as a 
lure for Spectres, or use the mist for more sinister purposes. Channeled into an object or person, the deathmist inflicts the subject with a debilitating, wasting illness. Furthermore, the focused energies are tainted and 
eerie, and though generally invisible (except to powers 
such as Aura Perception), they tend to cause people 
and animals to feel uncomfortable around the victim.
System: The player spends one blood point and rolls 
Willpower (difficult
powers.system:
The player spends one blood point and rolls 
Willpower (difficulty 8). Only one success is needed to 
draw out the Breath of Thanatos. If dispersed to summon Spectres, the energies cover roughly one-quarter 
of a mile (400 meters) in radius, centered around the 
necromancer. The range increases by an additional 
one-quarter mile or 400 meters for every additional 
blood point expended. 
Spectres summoned with this power will ignore the 
summoning necromancer for the duration of the power unless provoked, but may well go out of their way 
to wreak havoc on anyone else in the vicinity. The 
necromancer can then use other Necromancy powers 
(such as those in the Sepulchre Path) to manipulate 
and affect these Spectres.  Ghosts so targeted may then 
interact with the necromancer as normal, although the 
other Spectres in the area will continue to ignore both 
the vampire and the targeted ghost. This energy disperses after a scene, after which the Spectres leave to 
find new prey. Mechanics for Spectres can be found on 
p. 385.
If the cloud is directed toward a particular target, the 
necromancer must either touch the target or direct the 
stream of entropy using Dexterity + Occult (difficulty 
7). A target laden with entropy suffers one (and only 
one) level of aggravated damage; this generally manifests as sudden illness or decay. The target’s social difficulties while interacting with those unfamiliar with 
the touch of death — most normal humans, as well as 
some supernatural creatures — increase by 2. Furthermore, supernatural perceptions indicate the target is 
tainted with decay, which can be dangerous. This form 
of taint lasts until sunrise; a victim already plagued by 
this power cannot be affected again until the previous 
fog of entropy has dispersed.
A botch on the roll to control this power indicates 
that the vampire has turned the energy upon himself, 
and suffers all the effects of the vitriolic breath. This 
inflicts the usual injury and may subject the necromancer to the possibly dangerous attention of provoked 
Spectres and other creatures from beyond the grave.

powers.name: Night Cry
powers.description:
The breath of entropic energy becomes a scream of 
pure chaos. The necromancer can issue an unearthly cry 
(heard both in the living world and in the Shadowlands). 
The howl pours icy oblivion into a target or group of 
targets — either sweeping away the inherent entropy or 
collecting that destruction and unleashing it. 
System: The vampire chooses a number of targets 
within one yard or meter per dot of Necromancy and 
invokes Night Cry with a terrible scream. The player 
spends a Willpower point and a blood point for each 
target beyond the first. (In other words, she spends 
no blood if only going after one target, or one blood 
for two targets. Generational blood limits apply, and 
the vampire may not “pre-spend” blood prior to using 
Night Cry.) 
The player then chooses whether the vampire will aid 
or harm the targets, and rolls Manipulation + Occult 
(difficulty 6). If she chooses to aid the target or targets, 
each success gives each affected target a -2 difficulty 
modifier t

combination_disciplines.name: Blow of the Inner Beast
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 3, Potence 1, Presence 3.* **XP 21.** After dealing 3+ health levels (before soak), spend 1 BP to inflict the Beast's fright: the opponent's actions against the vampire are at +2 difficulty and require a **Courage (difficulty 8)** roll or **Rötschreck**.

combination_disciplines.name: Body of Statue
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 4, Protean 3 (Visceratika 3).* **XP 21.** Spend **2 BP** to turn the body to stone (fully over a few rounds). Immune to sunlight while stone; **double soak pool vs bashing**. The user is immobile and unaware; the statue does not hide the aura. Any single level of damage breaks the form.

combination_disciplines.name: Bone Regrowth
combination_disciplines.description: *Celerity 2, Vicissitude 3.* **XP 15.** Spend **1 BP**; for **Vicissitude** rounds regrow any lost bones (any size/type). Not skin or other flesh.

combination_disciplines.name: Bravo's Command
combination_disciplines.description: *Dominate 3, Potence 2.* **XP 12.** Known to Giovanni and Lasombra. When using Dominate 1 or 2, a display of strength lets the vampire **substitute Strength for Manipulation**. Dominated subjects obey fearfully.

combination_disciplines.name: Carnivale Fantastique
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 4, Mytherceria 5.* **XP 27.** Spend **1 Willpower**, roll **Manipulation + Performance (difficulty = target's Path rating)** while whispering to a sleeping/unconscious/torpid victim. The victim is trapped in a dream-paradise; they may escape with **Perception + Occult (difficulty 7)**. Otherwise they sleep until death from age/neglect, a

combination_disciplines.name: Chiaroscuro
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 1, Mytherceria 4.* **XP 15** (each painting 1 XP). Extended **Intelligence + Crafts (difficulty 6, 10 successes)** to create a painting with hidden symbolism. Viewers within 10 m cannot regain Willpower through sleep, and relive their worst act in nightmares. Ends when the victim loses a Humanity dot, succeeds on **Intelligence + Occult

combination_disciplines.name: Clustered Chaos
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 4, Dementation 3, Dominate 2.* **XP not visible in OCR (page break).** Spend **1 Willpower**, roll **Willpower (difficulty 6 + number of aides, max 10)**. Up to 4 nearby individuals who have ever tasted the user's blood add **1 automatic success each** to the user's Eyes of Chaos roll (they roll as if they also had it, silently). Aide targe

combination_disciplines.name: Coming Undone
combination_disciplines.description: *Potence 3, Temporis 4, Deny Relief.* **XP 21.** After a successful Brawl hit, roll **Intelligence + Occult vs the target's Willpower**: each success un-heals one increment of damage the target recently healed, **aggravated first**, then lethal, then bashing.

combination_disciplines.name: Command of Darkness
combination_disciplines.prereqs:
(Body heading reads "Command and Darkness"; appendix/index: "Command of
Darkness" — used here.)
combination_disciplines.description: *(Body heading reads "Command and Darkness"; appendix/index: "Command of Darkness" — used here.)* *Dominate 3, Obtenebration 1.* **XP 12.** Roll **Manipulation + Subterfuge (difficulty = victim's current Willpower)** vs the victim's **Self-Control + Subterfuge (difficulty = user's current Willpower)**. The winner forces eye contact; the winner may

combination_disciplines.name: Command the Beast
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 3, Dominate 3.* **XP 18.** Dominate now works on animals: roll as normal but substitute Animal Ken for the usual Ability. Dominate on animals is at +2 difficulty until Animalism 5. Can't affect lower Generation (a vampire inside the animal is also immune).

combination_disciplines.name: Command the Vassal
combination_disciplines.description: *Dominate 4, Presence 5, Empowered Domination.* **XP 27.** Reflexively spend 1 WP when using a Dominate power: the victim's Willpower counts 2 lower for the difficulty, and **mortals cannot spend Willpower to resist**. Utterly unsubtle — everyone in the room notices. Only works on Dominate 1–5; can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Confounding Mist
combination_disciplines.prereqs: Daimonion 3, Dominate 1, Opening the Gates of Mist.
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 3, Dominate 1, Opening the Gates of Mist.* **XP 12.** While using Dominate, reflexively spend 1 BP and roll **Willpower (difficulty 6)**: each success adds +1 (max 9) to the difficulty of the victim's attempts to avoid eye contact. The victim may resist with **Perception + Awareness (8)** but must beat *all* successes. Can't affect lower

combination_disciplines.name: Contemptuous Tenacity
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 5, Dominate 3.* **XP 24.** After Dominate is used on the vampire, spend **1 WP** to shrug it off and become **immune to that vampire's Dominate for the scene**. Only effective vs Dominate 1–5 (elder Dominate unaffected).

combination_disciplines.name: Deadly Mist Form
combination_disciplines.description: *Protean 5, Quietus 2.* **XP 21.** The vampire's Mist Form becomes a poison gas: anyone sharing its space is hit by **Scorpion's Touch** each round as though the user spent 1 BP (no blood cost). Only one individual at a time may be harmed.

combination_disciplines.name: Deceive the Beast
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 3, Chimerstry 4.* **XP 21.** Always on. Chimerstry illusions may be directed at animals as well as (or instead of) humans/Kindred. Useless if the ST already rules Chimerstry affects animals.

combination_disciplines.name: Defensive Insanity
combination_disciplines.description: *Dementation 2, Fortitude 2.* **XP 12.** Spend 1 BP: add **+1 die per 2 dots of Dementation** to the user's rolls for the turn, useful against Dominate-based attacks.

combination_disciplines.name: Dementate
combination_disciplines.description: *Dementation 4, Dominate 4.* **XP 24.** Roll **Manipulation + Intimidation (or Leadership, whichever is higher), difficulty = victim's current Willpower**. Each success drops 1 dot of a Mental Attribute (min 1) for **Willpower rating** turns, weakening the mind to suggestion. Can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Deny Relief
combination_disciplines.description: *Potence 2, Temporis 4.* **XP 18.** On a successful Brawl attack, spend **1 BP + 1 WP** and win a **contested Willpower roll**: the target **cannot heal wounds at all** — by blood, regeneration, or magic — for **Potence** rounds (others may heal them).

combination_disciplines.name: Displacement
combination_disciplines.description: *Celerity 4, Obfuscate 2.* **XP 18.** Only vs opponents with equal or less Auspex than the user's Obfuscate. When a melee attack misses, reflexively spend 1 BP and roll **Dexterity + Stealth vs Perception + Awareness (both difficulty 7)**: the user vanishes mid-miss, appearing behind the attacker or staying vanished.

combination_disciplines.name: Divine the Control
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 3, Dominate 4.* **XP 21.** With eye contact, roll **Perception + Subterfuge (difficulty = highest Dominate level used + 3)** to identify Dominate tampering: 1 = Dominate was used; 2 = which power; 3/4 = details (Dominate 2/3); 5 = who did it (if known). Can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Divine Visitation
combination_disciplines.description: *Obfuscate 3, Presence 3.* **XP 18.** Appear to a mortal (often from Obfuscate) as a deity/angel/spirit. Roll **Wits + Acting (6)**, each success adds a die to **Appearance + Intimidation (difficulty = victim's current Willpower)**; each success subtracts 1 WP from the victim. If fed upon during the power the mortal counts half Willpower. At 0 WP s

combination_disciplines.name: Doppelganger
combination_disciplines.description: *Dementation 7, Dominate 5.* **XP 36.** Spend 1 WP; roll **Charisma + Intimidation** vs the victim's **Willpower (both difficulty 7)**. Each net success drains 1 temporary WP. Only an attacker botch frees the victim (and immunizes them for the story). At 0 WP the vampire takes over body and mind: Physical Attributes from the vessel, own Social/Ment

combination_disciplines.name: Down the Gates of Mist
combination_disciplines.prereqs: Auspex 5, Daimonion 3, Opening the Gates of Mist.
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 5, Daimonion 3, Opening the Gates of Mist.* **XP 24.** After using Opening the Gates of Mist, roll **Intelligence + Occult (8)**; each success transports one extra being (+ belongings). Transport takes 3 turns and fails if the caster is damaged; only to places the caster has physically visited. Arrival requires a **Willpower (6)** roll or 1

combination_disciplines.name: Draconic Visage
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 4, Protean 4 (Serpentis 4 or Vicissitude 4).* **XP 24.** Spend **3 BP**: gain dragon scales (1 soak die of armor; vs natural/out-of-control fire that 1 die becomes **2 automatic soak successes**) and wings (flight 15 mph / 21 m per turn, hover-capable, carry 20 lb/10 kg).

combination_disciplines.name: Empowered Domination
combination_disciplines.description: *Dominate 3, Presence 2.* **XP 15.** Roll **Charisma + Intimidation (difficulty = victim's Wits + Courage)**: each success adds a bonus die to Dominate 1–2 rolls against that target. Only direct commands (user must look intimidating). Can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Enduring Mask
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 2, Obfuscate 3.* **XP 15.** While using Mask of a Thousand Faces, cameras and electronics record the *mask*, never the true face (not even early photography). Anyone who sees past the Obfuscate sees the truth, but no device can.

combination_disciplines.name: Enduring Summoning
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 3, Presence 4.* **XP 21.** Whenever the user is staked, they may spend 1 temporary WP and activate Presence 4 – Summoning.

combination_disciplines.name: Enticing Work
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 3, Presence 4.* **XP 21.** Roll **Charisma + Empathy (8)** while holding an object to imbue it with Presence; everyone who encounters it desires it. The object must be skill-made (creator had the relevant Crafts at 3+).

combination_disciplines.name: Eye of the Corpse
combination_disciplines.prereqs: Auspex 3, Paths of the Corpse in the Monster 3 (The Grave's Decay 3).
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 3, Paths of the Corpse in the Monster 3 (The Grave's Decay 3).* **XP 18.** Touch a corpse's head/skull and gaze into its eyes, rolling **Perception + Occult (8)**: 1 = the moment of death; 2 = last memories; 3 = most of the life; 4 = only what the subject remembered; 5 = even forgotten memories. Works on vampires who met Final Death (diffic

combination_disciplines.name: Eyes of a Thousand Shades
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 1, Necromancy 3.* **XP 12.** Spend 1 BP and roll **Wits + Investigation/Occult + Auspex (9)** to see through previously-enslaved ghosts as "spook surveillance." Success = view through all ghosts in a large building (flip between them reflexively), Perception at −3 (filmy Shroud-vision); 5+ successes = perfect clarity. Botch = see something

combination_disciplines.name: Fatuus Aegis
combination_disciplines.description: *Chimerstry 5, Fortitude 3.* **XP 24.** Spend 1 WP: immune to Horrid Reality and related illusion-damage (still can't tell illusion from truth). No effect if the attacker's Chimerstry exceeds the user's.

combination_disciplines.name: Fire Shield
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 3, Protean 5.* **XP 24.** Spend 1 BP per use: treat **fire as lethal** for that instance of damage. Usable reactively against incoming fire if the user perceives the attack (e.g. a Lure of the Flames bolt).

combination_disciplines.name: Fortitude of the Mind
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 4, Fortitude 4.* **XP 24.** Add Fortitude to resist mind-oriented attacks, or to Willpower rolls vs Mental attacks. Does not alter static difficulties or grant extra WP.

combination_disciplines.name: Fumbled Words
combination_disciplines.description: *Dominate 2, Temporis 3.* **XP 15.** With Mesmerize available (usually eye contact), roll **Manipulation + Leadership vs target (difficulty 7)**. If the vampire wins, a subject who just failed a speech-related roll must re-roll with a penalty equal to the user's Dominate rating. Victim is immune for 24 h after a successful resist. Can't affect lowe

combination_disciplines.name: Garden of Deadly Delights
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 3, Mytherceria 3.* **XP 18.** Grow a garden (10+ m², open sky) of toxic plants over one lunar month (1 BP/night; +1 BP per extra 10 m). Requires an **Intelligence + Science (7)** roll. Once established, spend 1 BP and roll **Manipulation + Survival (6)**: thorn-vines flail and pollen billows; everyone in the garden except the Baali takes

combination_disciplines.name: Hamlet's Vision
combination_disciplines.description: *Dominate 2, Obfuscate 4.* **XP 18.** Roll **Manipulation + Stealth (difficulty = victim's Willpower)**; each success lets the vampire allow one more person to see them through the Obfuscate (commonly a dead relative). Double-layering with Mask of a Thousand Faces costs 1 WP. Can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Hastened Recovery
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 2, Temporis 5.* **XP 21.** Once per 48 h, spend **2 WP** to instantly heal up to Fortitude rating of **aggravated** damage (1 BP per point healed). Not blocked by Deny Relief.

combination_disciplines.name: Heart of the Beast
combination_disciplines.prereqs: Animalism 5, Protean 5, Heart of the Wolf.
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 5, Protean 5, Heart of the Wolf.* **XP 30.** Take Hispo form (total 3 BP): Strength +3, Dexterity +2, Stamina +3; bite Strength +2 aggravated (diff 5), claw Strength +1 lethal (diff 6); 4–6 ft shoulder, 350–800 lb; **−1 difficulty on all Perception rolls**. Garou who can sense the Wyrm see through it if suspicious.

combination_disciplines.name: Heart of the Wolf
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 4, Protean 4.* **XP 24.** Shift to wolf (Protean 4); spend 1 extra BP for Lupus-form attributes/senses: Strength +1, Dexterity +2, Stamina +2; bite Strength +1 aggravated (diff 5), claw Strength +1 lethal (diff 6); 3–4 ft shoulder, 120–250 lb; **−2 difficulty on Perception rolls**, run at 2× speed. The wolf appears alive to all. ## I

combination_disciplines.name: Identify the Unholy
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 2, Valeren 1.* **XP 9.** Like Aura Perception but needs **2 successes minimum**; looking for marks of unholiness: 2 = black/red aura on unholy relics; 3 = unholy ground glows; 4 = spot any Road-of-the-Hive adherent (rating 8+); 5 = see a Baali's swarm of insect-like aura-creatures.

combination_disciplines.name: Illusionary Beauty
combination_disciplines.description: *Chimerstry 3, Presence 3.* **XP 18.** Channel Presence 1–3 through illusions: the illusory gem draws all attention (Awe), fire terrifies (Dread Gaze), an ethereal beauty entrances (Entrancement). Roll the Presence power at +1 difficulty; the effect lasts until disbelieved or ended.

combination_disciplines.name: Imbuing the Beast Lord
combination_disciplines.prereqs: Animalism 4, Celerity 2, Fortitude 2, Potence 2, Feral Imbuing.
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 4, Celerity 2, Fortitude 2, Potence 2, Feral Imbuing.* **XP 30.** Roll **Strength + Animal Ken (6)** and transfer dots of Celerity/Fortitude/Potence to an animal in line of sight (up to the successes, never more than possessed); the vampire's own ratings drop for the duration. Withdrawable reflexively.

combination_disciplines.name: Invisibility
combination_disciplines.description: *Chimerstry 3, Obfuscate 3.* **XP 18.** Spend 1 WP to bend light: invisible on electronic/video recording, while retaining all Obfuscate advantages. Breakable by anything that breaks Obfuscate; infrared still detects body heat.

combination_disciplines.name: Iron Arms
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 1, Potence 1.* **XP 6.** Always on. Eliminates recoil with guns. ## J

combination_disciplines.name: Just a Scratch
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 2, Protean 2 (Vicissitude 2).* **XP 12.** Each blood point spent to heal bashing heals **2 bashing**. No extra healing of lethal/aggravated; no exceeding Generation limits; headshot-lethal still applies. ## K

combination_disciplines.name: Know the Bestial Mind
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 4, Auspex 4.* **XP 24.** Gaze into an animal's eyes and roll **Perception + Animal Ken (6–9)** to pluck memories/images; the more successes the clearer, and the difficulty rises with the memory's importance to the animal.

combination_disciplines.name: Knowing Dagon's Call
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 4, Quietus 3.* **XP 21.** Always on. Whenever the user uses Dagon's Call, they instantly know the damage dealt (after the contested Stamina roll, before soak).

combination_disciplines.name: Kraken's Shadow
combination_disciplines.description: *Obtenebration 3 – Arms of Ahriman, Potence 3.* **XP 18.** When using Arms of Ahriman (not Arms of the Abyss), spend **1 WP**: all tentacles gain **half the user's Potence (rounded down)** for the scene. ## L

combination_disciplines.name: Larger Shape of the Beasts
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 4, Protean 4, Understanding the Beast.* **XP 24.** As Protean 4 – Shape of the Beast, but almost any beast up to **5× the vampire's own weight**.

combination_disciplines.name: Legion
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 7, Dominate 5.* **XP 36.** Touch a mortal and roll **Manipulation + Intimidation (difficulty = victim's Willpower)** to possess their body. Works best in crowds; change bodies up to **Manipulation** times per day. The vessel keeps the vampire's Traits except Strength/Dexterity/Stamina/Appearance and Physical Merits/ Flaws. Original Attri

combination_disciplines.name: Mass Invisibility
combination_disciplines.description: *Chimerstry 4, Obfuscate 5, Invisibility.* **XP 27.** As Invisibility, but renders a group invisible — 1 extra person per dot of Stealth. Costs 1 WP to activate.

combination_disciplines.name: Medusa's Gaze
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 1, Mytherceria 4 (Serpentis 4), Presence 2.* **XP 21.** Spend 1 BP and roll **Charisma + Intimidation (difficulty = target's Willpower)**: the target is frozen in stone (mental actions still allowed). Damage to the statue deals half as lethal to the trapped victim; 10 lethal/aggravated frees them (soak applies). Victim may spend temporary W

combination_disciplines.name: Might of the Beast
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 5, Potence 2.* **XP 21.** During frenzy, spend 1 WP and roll **Manipulation + Self-Control (8)**: each success +1 Strength. Failure = frenzy; botch = frenzy + a Derangement.

combination_disciplines.name: Mind Flayer
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 4, Vicissitude 2.* **XP 18.** Range 5 m × Intelligence; no line of sight needed (but must know the target is in range). Breaks Obfuscate. Vs mortals: **Intelligence + Medicine (difficulty = target's Willpower; Iron Will applies)**, 1 lethal per success. Vs vampires/supernaturals: contested Intelligence + Medicine vs Willpower (both difficul

combination_disciplines.name: Mine the Myth
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 1, Mytherceria 1.* **XP 6.** Roll **Perception + Empathy (difficulty = target's Humanity/Path)**: on success, the vampire learns the most heinous, damaging lie the subject ever told.

combination_disciplines.name: Molecular Awareness
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 4, Vicissitude 5.* **XP 27.** Leave a quarter-sized drop of self-aware blood (1 BP), then roll **Perception + Empathy (6)** later to perceive around it: 1 = 100 yd; 2 = 1 mile; 3 = 10 miles; 4 = 100 miles; 5 = 1,000 miles. Botch = wrong info. The blood stays aware until the vampire sleeps/torpor; multiple drops allowed. Consumed by another,

combination_disciplines.name: Money for Nothing
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 3, Mytherceria 2.* **XP 15.** Roll **Manipulation + Occult (4)** and ritually kill a mortal acquaintance of the recipient (4 BP gained from the act). The recipient gains 1 dot per success in a mundane Background (Resources, Status, Fame, Influence — not Generation), manifesting 1 dot per night as lucky streaks. The recipient must willing

combination_disciplines.name: Net of Shadows
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 2, Obtenebration 3.* **XP 15.** Spend 1 BP and roll **Manipulation + Occult (6)** to lay a flat shadow trap that springs when a sentient steps on it (can't fool targets with Obfuscate above the creator's Auspex). Arms grapple with **Dexterity + Brawl (5)** using the creator's Obtenebration + Celerity for Dexterity; escape requires equalling

combination_disciplines.name: Obscuring Mist
combination_disciplines.prereqs: Daimonion 3, Obfuscate 5, Opening the Gates of Mist.
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 3, Obfuscate 5, Opening the Gates of Mist.* **XP 24.** Use Opening the Gates of Mist, then spend 1 WP: the mists densify and channel the user's Obfuscate (1–5) over the whole cloud (Cloak the Gathering's subject cap doubled). Auspex/piercing powers roll as if the vampire's Obfuscate matched them. Lasts a scene; aggressive action by those

combination_disciplines.name: Oh Look, I Died
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 1, Celerity 1, Thanatosis 3.* **XP 15.** When attacked (perceived), reflexively spend 1 BP (supersedes Ashes to Ashes' cost) to assume ash form the instant the attack lands, making it look like Final Death. All Ashes to Ashes benefits/drawbacks apply.

combination_disciplines.name: One Side of the Soul
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 4, Dominate 4, Self-Mastery.* **XP 24.** Spend 1 BP, look at your own reflection, and roll **Charisma + Leadership (6)**: every 2 successes raise 1 Physical Attribute (up to Generational max) for the scene. Lasombra (no reflection) cannot use it.

combination_disciplines.name: Opening the Gates of Mist
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 3, Daimonion 3, Obfuscate 1, (optional Dominate 1).* **XP 21 (24).** Spend 1 BP to conjure a thick, odourless mist (1 m radius, controllable 1 m/turn, max height 3 m). It lasts until dispelled, immune to wind/elements below the user's Daimonion; anyone inside counts as touched/seen for Discipline delivery. Filling an area blinds those insid

combination_disciplines.name: Panacea
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 2, Obeah 3 (Valeren – Healer 3).* **XP 15.** Spend 1 WP and roll **Willpower (9)**: successes set the max health levels restored; licking a wound heals any damage (including aggravated) at 1 BP per health level.

combination_disciplines.name: Perceive the Beast Within
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 3, Auspex 1.* **XP 12.** Roll **Perception + Awareness (7)** to sense Beasts: 1 = ghouls (5 yd); 2 = ghouls, Kindred (10 yd); 3 = same (20 yd); 4 = same (40 yd); 5+ = +Garou (80 yd). Does not break Obfuscate or pinpoint location.

combination_disciplines.name: Phasing
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 3, Vicissitude 3.* **XP 18.** Spend 1 BP and roll **Intelligence + Body Crafts (6)** to phase through bars/gates you can see (openings ≥ 1 inch/2.5 cm). Mass is redistributed, not reduced; botch = 1 lethal per 1 rolled.

combination_disciplines.name: Poison of Blood
combination_disciplines.description: *Protean 2, Quietus 4.* **XP 18.** Wound a victim to inject vitae (up to health levels dealt, Feral Claws only; Generation limits). With blood inside, use Quietus 2/3 remotely (each attempt burns 1 BP), or roll **contested Willpower (8)** to spend injected BP as **unsoakable aggravated** damage. Injected blood is usable only for the scene.

combination_disciplines.name: Public Confession
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 2, Presence 2.* **XP 12.** Roll **Manipulation + Empathy (difficulty = victim's Willpower)** while goading them to confess: the victim blurts out their most sinful act, loudly and to any audience/cameras. Usable in combat as an action (not a split action). ## Q

combination_disciplines.name: Quash the Alteration of Flesh
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 2, Vicissitude 2 (Visceratika 2).* **XP 12.** Reflexively spend 1 BP when a Vicissitude change is applied to the user: add their Vicissitude (or Visceratika) rating to resist it. ## R

combination_disciplines.name: Rage Wind
combination_disciplines.description: *Celerity 4, Presence 4.* **XP 24.** Spend 1 WP and roll **Charisma + Leadership (7)**; then a **Self-Control/Instincts (8)** roll governs control. Affects 5 vampires per dot of Leadership. Willing/failed subjects enter a *controlled* frenzy: +1 Physical Attribute (up to 1 above Generational max) for the frenzy's duration, attacking only known enem

combination_disciplines.name: Rapid Fire Bones
combination_disciplines.description: *Celerity 2, Vicissitude 3.* **XP 15.** Spend 1 BP and roll **Dexterity + Medicine (6)**: fire bone fragments (Strength + 1 lethal, range 5 × Strength meters), one per Celerity action. Bones regrow instantly on firing.

combination_disciplines.name: Rapid Shift
combination_disciplines.description: *Celerity 3, Obtenebration 4 (Protean 4, Serpentis 4, Vicissitude 4).* **XP 21.** Spend 1 BP to assume any possessed form (1–5) in a single turn. Elder forms (6+) unaffected.

combination_disciplines.name: Read the Sculptor's Clay
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 2, Vicissitude 2.* **XP 12.** Taste blood (**Perception + Medicine, difficulty 7**) or observe (**1 BP; Perception + Medicine, difficulty 8**, lowered by 1/2/3 per turn for stationary/active/exerting targets) — each success yields one piece of info (illness, supernatural nature, magic, Generation, clan/bloodline, attributes, injury, diabler

combination_disciplines.name: Relinquish the Soul's Vessel
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 1, Vicissitude 3.* **XP 12.** Spend 1 BP and roll **Intelligence + Medicine (7)** to remove a heart (own or another's; failure = 4 aggravated). The heart must be caged in 5+ lb of living flesh. While out, the vampire can't be staked and **−2 difficulty on frenzy-resistance rolls**. The heart needs 1 BP per month (else torpor). Only fire or

combination_disciplines.name: Resilient Senses
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 1, Fortitude 1.* **XP 6.** Always on. Add Fortitude to rolls resisting non-supernatural blinding, bedazzlement, or sensory overload.

combination_disciplines.name: Roy Cohn's Blessing
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 1, Necromancy 1.* **XP 6.** Spend 1 BP and roll **Perception + Law (7)**: each success adds automatic successes to find loopholes/manipulations in a legal contract. (Consult damned lawyers' criticism, not drafting help.) ## S

combination_disciplines.name: Second Face
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 1, Obfuscate 3.* **XP 12** (each additional mask after the first 6 XP). Pick a single visage; piercing it is +2 difficulty, and the user's Obfuscate counts 1 dot higher for See the Unseen purposes.

combination_disciplines.name: Second Time is the Charm
combination_disciplines.description: *Celerity 1, Temporis 3.* **XP 12.** Reflexively spend 1 BP to reroll a non-combat roll (once per roll; never a botch).

combination_disciplines.name: Self-Mastery
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 3, Dominate 3.* **XP 18.** Dominate yourself: roll the Dominate power's Attribute + Ability at **difficulty 10 − (Dominate rating / 2, rounded down)**. Dominate 1/2 forces the self to act and counters other supernatural powers (successes add to the next non-combat action). Also aids frenzy/Rötschreck resistance. Dominate 3 can erase unhealt

combination_disciplines.name: Sense Amaranth
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 2, Necromancy 1 (Sepulchre Path).* **XP 9.** Roll **Perception + Empathy (8)**; success reveals how many times the subject committed diablerie; each extra success shows one victim and roughly when. Requires diablerie marks in the aura.

combination_disciplines.name: Shadowed Seraph
combination_disciplines.description: *Celerity 2, Obtenebration 4, Potence 4.* **XP 30.** Grow black-feathered shadow wings: flight 30 mph / 42 m per turn, carry 20 lb/10 kg.

combination_disciplines.name: Shatter the Impressions
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 5, Presence 3.* **XP 24.** After Presence is used on the user, spend 1 WP to shrug it off and be **immune to that vampire's Presence for the scene**. Only vs Presence 1–5 (elder Presence unaffected); can't be used against lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Smell of Unseelie
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 2, Mytherceria 2.* **XP 12.** Always on. Within 3 m of an Unseelie Fae the user automatically detects a noxious smell (rotting garbage, burnt flesh, or feces).

combination_disciplines.name: Soften the Wild Claws
combination_disciplines.description: *(OCR heading: "Soiten the Wild Claws" — corrected.)* *Animalism 3, Fortitude 3.* **XP 18.** Reduce soak difficulties vs animal-like attacks by 2. Vs Lupine bite/claw attacks, spend 1 WP for the improved soak for the scene. Covers Protean damage and animal-like attacks (incl. Vicissitude-altered natural creatures); not vampire bites or Vicissitude

combination_disciplines.name: Speed of the Bullet
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 1, Celerity 2.* **XP 9.** Always on. Dodge any firearm the user is aware of without diving for cover.

combination_disciplines.name: Spider Climb
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 2, Potence 2, Protean 2 (Vicissitude 2).* **XP 18.** Spend 1 BP to adhere to ceilings/walls for hours equal to total Animalism + Potence + Protean (or Vicissitude). Athletic maneuvers use **Dexterity + Athletics (7)**.

combination_disciplines.name: Spirit of the Eternal Muse
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 4, Presence 3.* **XP 21.** Roll **Humanity/Path (7)** to inspire a protégé into an ecstatic creative state (both parties share the Toreador weakness for the duration); each success is an automatic success on the protégé's Performance roll. The pupil must have studied with the patron for 12 − Humanity/Path months. Mortals only.

combination_disciplines.name: Spot the Controlled
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 2, Dominate 2.* **XP 12.** After Aura Perception, roll **Perception + Empathy (8)**: more successes than the dominator's Dominate dots confirm the target is under Dominate (not who, what, or past uses). Can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Stone Flesh
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 4, Protean 4.* **XP 24.** Spend 2 BP: soak difficulties −1, and soak all aggravated damage (except fire/sunlight) with full Stamina + Fortitude, for a scene. (A duplicate of the elder Fortitude power under Protean prerequisites.)

combination_disciplines.name: Stronghold
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 2, Potence 2.* **XP 12.** Spend 1 WP and concentrate (no dodging): add Potence (max 5, no blood-automatics) as extra soak dice vs bashing. If an attacker deals 3+ health levels, the user must make **Courage (9)** or spend 1 WP for any action vs that foe for the scene.

combination_disciplines.name: Stunning Mask
combination_disciplines.description: *Obfuscate 3, Presence 1.* **XP 12.** When raising Appearance via Mask of a Thousand Faces, pay a number of BP less equal to the Presence rating (min 1 BP). ## T

combination_disciplines.name: Talk to Consumed Souls
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 4, Necromancy (Sepulchre Path) 1, Sense Amaranth.* **XP 15.** Roll **Intelligence + Subterfuge (difficulty = the diablerizer's Willpower)** to telepathically speak with a diablerized soul (need an image of the target). With Compel Soul, issue commands (the diablerizer counts as a fetter in most cases).

combination_disciplines.name: The Beast Mask
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 4, Protean 4.* **XP 24** (each additional mask 24 XP). Enter an animal via Subsume the Spirit, stay 24 h, then ritualize it as a personal guide. The Mask grants a half-animal form with bonuses (Bat/Raven: Dex +3, flight = land move; Bear: Str +2, Dex +1, Sta +2; Fox: Str +1, Dex +2, Sta +2; Rat: Str +1, Dex +3, Sta +1; Tiger: swim = land

combination_disciplines.name: The Crazed Beast
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 2, Dementation 3.* **XP 15.** Roll **Manipulation + Animal Ken (7)** on one animal: 1–3 successes = it flees; 4+ = it attacks its owner. Duration: 1 = 1 night; 2 = 1 week; 3 = 1 month; 4 = 1 year; 5+ = permanent. Ghouls resist with a **Willpower (7)** roll subtracting successes.

combination_disciplines.name: The Domineering Mist
combination_disciplines.prereqs: Dominate 1, Opening the Gates of Mist.
combination_disciplines.description: *Dominate 1, Opening the Gates of Mist.* **XP 3.** Spend 1 BP per attempt: Dominate 1–5 can be used on targets inside the mist **without eye contact**. Can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: The Perfect Murder
combination_disciplines.description: *Daimonion 1, Dominate 2, Presence 3.* **XP 18.** After a 10-minute conversation about how to commit the perfect murder, spend 1 WP and roll **Manipulation + Larceny (difficulty = victim's Willpower)**: the mortal becomes bound to murder someone they hate, dislike, or find annoying. They must spend 1 WP per day or take steps toward the crime; they

combination_disciplines.name: The Unseen Noah
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 3, Obfuscate 2.* **XP 15.** Always on. Obfuscate now works on animals; choose to be hidden from both man and beast, humans only, or animals only.

combination_disciplines.name: Thick Hide
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 2, Protean 3.* **XP 15.** Spend 1 BP and roll **Stamina (6)**: each success adds 1 point of armor for **Stamina** rounds. Does not soak aggravated.

combination_disciplines.name: Trap of Vitae
combination_disciplines.description: *Obfuscate 5, Quietus 3.* **XP 24.** Spend 1–3 BP in a spot and roll **Wits + Stealth (8)** to conceal a pool of acidic vitae. Anyone stepping in takes **1–3 aggravated** (per BP); damage they soak stays in the pool to hit others. Potent until sunrise. ## U

combination_disciplines.name: Understanding the Beast
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 3, Protean 4.* **XP 21.** Touch a creature and roll **Charisma + Animal Ken (8)** to learn its shape; failure = try again another night; botch = the animal attacks. Transforms only to creatures ≤ the vampire's own weight (min 1 lb).

combination_disciplines.name: Unphased Usage
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 1, Vicissitude 3.* **XP 12.** No health-level damage when using Bonecraft on your own body (drawing bones, spikes, talons, quills). ## V

combination_disciplines.name: Vapor of Consumption
combination_disciplines.prereqs:
(OCR variant in the index: "Vapor of Compulsion" — the body heading "Vapor of
Consumption" is used here.)
combination_disciplines.description: *(OCR variant in the index: "Vapor of Compulsion" — the body heading "Vapor of Consumption" is used here.)* *Dominate 2, Protean 5.* **XP 21.** While in Mist Form, spend 1 WP: Dominate 1–2 may be used on any target within the vapor **as though making eye contact**, at +1 difficulty. Can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Vile Metamorphosis
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 4, Obfuscate 3.* **XP 21.** Spend 2 BP to collapse into a swarm (tarantulas, rats, etc.) of **5 creatures per remaining BP** after activation. Each 5 destroyed costs the user 1 BP; when the final 5 are destroyed the user reforms from the last creature in torpor from blood loss. ## W

combination_disciplines.name: Ward of Domination
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 3, Dominate 2.* **XP 15.** Inscribe a ward and roll **Manipulation + Occult (6)**: anyone touching the object receives a Dominate-2 command/suggestion. Duration: 1 = 1 day; 2 = 1 week; 3 = 1 month; 4 = 1 year; 5+ = permanent. If the vampire is present within 10 m they may issue a substitute command. Can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Wear the Bestial Skins
combination_disciplines.description: *Animalism 3, Vicissitude 3.* **XP 18.** Fleshcraft skins of feathers, fur, chitin, quills, or scales (1 BP per body part; Dex + Animal Ken roll difficulty 7 after a standard Fleshcraft roll). Grants up to +1 damage, +1 soak, or +1 armor; other effects at ST discretion.

combination_disciplines.name: Whispering Mists
combination_disciplines.prereqs: Auspex 4, Opening the Gates of Mist.
combination_disciplines.description: *Auspex 4, Opening the Gates of Mist.* **XP 12.** Roll **Intelligence + Subterfuge (difficulty = subject's Willpower)** to charge the mist with psychic energy; for a scene the mist silently delivers any Discipline effect that requires the vampire to speak (becoming its focus/source). Other costs/rolls as normal.

combination_disciplines.name: Winsayers in the Dark
combination_disciplines.description: *(OCR index variant: "Whispers in the Dark.")* *Dominate 1, Obfuscate 3.* **XP 12.** An Obfuscated vampire can use Dominate on a victim without revealing her presence (Auspex and other piercers still work). Can't affect lower Generation.

combination_disciplines.name: Winter's Reprieve
combination_disciplines.description: *Fortitude 3, Protean 3.* **XP 18.** Spend 1 BP: immune to cold of any temperature for hours equal to Stamina + Fortitude + Protean. Equipment/clothing not immune.

combination_disciplines.name: Wipe Out
combination_disciplines.description: *Dominate 4, Obfuscate 4.* **XP 24.** With eye contact, roll **Charisma + Intimidation (difficulty = target's Willpower)** to blank a mind: no Skills/Knowledges/non-Physical Disciplines; Attributes/Talents instinctive only. Duration: 1 = 1 scene; 2 = 2 scenes; 3 = 5 scenes + 1 WP loss; 4 = 1 night + 2 WP; 5+ = 1 week + 3 WP. A botch locks the power

sections.title: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
LA Campaign: The Coterie & Inner Circle

entries.title: Anarch
entries.content: 1) A member of the Anarch Movement. 2) Any Kindred rebel who opposes the tyranny of elders.

entries.title: Anarch Movement, The
entries.content: The Sect within the Camarilla comprised of Anarchs who want to reform or overthrow the rule of the elders.

entries.title: Barrens, The
entries.content: The areas of a city unfit for life, including graveyards, abandoned buildings, industrial wastelands, and areas of irreversible urban blight.

entries.title: Beast, The
entries.content: The inchoate drives and urges that threaten to turn a vampire into a mindless, ravening monster.

entries.title: Becoming, The
entries.content: The moment one passes from being a fledgling into 'full' vampire status as a neonate. In the Camarilla, one may not Become until her sire deems her ready and gains the Prince's approval.

entries.title: Blood
entries.content: A vampire's heritage; that which makes a vampire a vampire. (e.g., 'I doubt her claims to such esteemed Blood.')

entries.title: Blood Bond
entries.content: A mystical power over another individual engendered by partaking of a particular vampire's blood thrice; accepting blood from a vampire is an acknowledgment of her mastery.

entries.title: Book of Nod, The
entries.content: A collection of Kindred legend and history recounting the First City and Caine's wanderings.

entries.title: Caitiff
entries.content: A vampire of unknown Clan, or of no Clan at all. Caitiff are typically of high Generation, where Caine's blood is too diluted to pass on any consistent characteristics.

entries.title: Camarilla, The
entries.content: A global Sect of vampires devoted primarily to maintaining the Traditions, particularly that of the Masquerade.

entries.title: Childe
entries.content: A vampire created through the Embrace — the childe is the progeny of her sire. Often used derogatorily to indicate inexperience. Plural: childer.

entries.title: Clan
entries.content: A group of vampires who share common characteristics passed on by the blood. There are 13 known Clans, all of which were reputedly founded by members of the Third Generation.

entries.title: Coterie
entries.content: A small group of Kindred, united by the need for support and sometimes common interests. In the Sabbat, coteries are called packs.

entries.title: Diablerie
entries.content: The consumption of another Kindred's blood, to the point of the victim's Final Death. Vampires may lower their Generation permanently through this abhorrent practice. Also known as the Amaranth.

entries.title: Domain
entries.content: The area of a particular vampire's influence. Princes claim entire cities as their domains, sometimes granting lesser vampires domain within.

entries.title: Elder
entries.content: A vampire who has experienced two or more centuries of unlife. Elders are the most active participants in the Jyhad.

entries.title: Elysium
entries.content: A place where vampires may gather without fear of harm under the Pax Vampirica. Commonly established in opera houses, theaters, museums, and other locales of culture.

entries.title: Embrace, The
entries.content: The act of transforming a mortal into a vampire. The Embrace requires draining the victim and replacing that blood with a bit of vampiric vitae.

entries.title: Final Death, The
entries.content: When a vampire ceases to exist, crossing the line from undead into permanent death.

entries.title: Fledgling
entries.content: A newly created vampire, still under her sire's tutelage and protection.

entries.title: Gehenna
entries.content: The rumored Armageddon when the Antediluvians will rise from their torpor and devour the race of vampires and the world.

entries.title: Generation
entries.content: The number of 'steps' between a vampire and the mythical Caine; how far descended from the First Vampire a given vampire is.

entries.title: Ghoul
entries.content: A minion created by giving a bit of vampiric vitae to a mortal without draining her of blood first, conferring stopped aging, enhanced strength, and blood dependence.

entries.title: Haven
entries.content: A vampire's 'home'; where she finds sanctuary and security from the sun.

entries.title: Hunger, The
entries.content: The urge to feed. For vampires, the Hunger replaces all other physical drives with its own powerful call.

entries.title: Inconnu
entries.content: A Sect of vampires who have removed themselves from Kindred concerns and, largely, the Jyhad. Many Methuselahs are rumored to exist among the Inconnu.

entries.title: Jyhad, The
entries.content: The secret, self-destructive war waged between the Generations. Elder vampires manipulate their lessers, using them as pawns in a terrible game whose rules defy comprehension.

entries.title: Kindred
entries.content: The race of vampires as a whole, or a single vampire. Sabbat vampires scorn the term, preferring 'Cainite'.

entries.title: Kiss, The
entries.content: To drink blood, especially from a mortal. The Kiss causes feelings of intense ecstasy in those who receive it.

entries.title: Life, The
entries.content: A euphemism for mortal blood. Regarded by many Kindred as affected and effete.

entries.title: Lupine
entries.content: A werewolf, the natural and mortal enemy of the vampire race.

entries.title: Lush
entries.content: A vampire who typically feeds from drugged or drunk mortals in order to experience their inebriation vicariously.

entries.title: Man, The
entries.content: The mote of humanity that a vampire maintains; the spark of mortality that distinguishes him from the Beast.

entries.title: Masquerade, The
entries.content: The habit (and First Tradition) of hiding the existence of vampires from humanity to prevent persecution.

entries.title: Prince
entries.content: A vampire who has claimed a given expanse of domain as her own, generally a city, and supports that claim against all others. Refers to a Kindred of either sex.

entries.title: Rogue
entries.content: A vampire who feeds upon the vitae of other Cainites, out of necessity or depravity.

entries.title: Sabbat, The
entries.content: A Sect of vampires that rejects humanity, embracing their monstrous natures and waging crusade against the Antediluvians.

entries.title: Sect
entries.content: A group of vampires arguably united under a common philosophy. The three primary Sects are the Camarilla, the Sabbat, and the Anarch Movement.

entries.title: Sire
entries.content: A vampire's 'parent'; the Kindred who created her through the Embrace.

entries.title: Vessel
entries.content: A source of vitae for sustenance or pleasure, primarily mortal.

entries.title: Amaranth
entries.content: The act of consuming another Kindred's blood and soul; the formal, classical term for diablerie.

entries.title: Ancilla
entries.content: A 'proven' vampire, intermediate in age and status between the neonates and the elders (typically 50 to 200 years of unlife). Plural: ancillae.

entries.title: Antediluvian
entries.content: A member of the dreaded Third Generation, grandchild of Caine, and progenitor of a major Clan.

entries.title: Antitribu
entries.content: An 'anti-Clan'; one who has turned her back on the Sect that her Clan founded (usually by joining the Sabbat).

entries.title: Autarkis
entries.content: A Kindred who remains fiercely outside the larger vampire society of a given city, acknowledging neither Prince, Baron, nor Archbishop.

entries.title: Blood Oath
entries.content: The classical and formal term for a blood bond.

entries.title: Cainite
entries.content: A vampire; a member of the race of Caine. Favored by elders, scholars, and the Sabbat.

entries.title: Canaille
entries.content: The bovine masses of humanity, especially the uncultured and unsavory, viewed primarily as herds for sustenance.

entries.title: Cauchemar
entries.content: A vampire who feeds exclusively on sleeping victims, leaving them undisturbed.

entries.title: Consanguineous
entries.content: Literally 'of the same blood'; denoting shared lineage or Clan descent.

entries.title: Cunctator
entries.content: A vampire who avoids killing when delivering the Kiss, taking only small amounts of blood across multiple prey.

entries.title: Domitor
entries.content: A ghoul's master; one who feeds blood and issues commands to an indentured servant.

entries.title: Footpad
entries.content: One who feeds from derelicts, vagrants, and the chaff of society, often lacking a permanent haven.

entries.title: Gentry
entries.content: Kindred who frequent nightclubs, theaters, and red-light districts to hunt among affluent revelers.

entries.title: Golconda
entries.content: A fabled state of vampiric enlightenment and transcendence, mastering the Beast and achieving inner peace.

entries.title: Humanitas
entries.content: The extent to which a Kindred preserves mortal conscience, empathy, and ethical restraint.

entries.title: Kine
entries.content: A contemptuous archaic term for mortals ('cattle').

entries.title: Leech
entries.content: A mortal who drinks vampire blood yet acknowledges no domitor, or an unbonded rogue ghoul.

entries.title: Lextalionis
entries.content: The ancient code of Kindred retributive justice ('an eye for an eye'); the formal decree of a blood hunt.

entries.title: Lineage
entries.content: A vampire's genealogical pedigree: sire, sire's sire, and ancestral descent from the Antediluvians.

entries.title: Methuselah
entries.content: A vampire of the Fourth or Fifth Generation who has survived for a millennium or more, largely detached from mortal concerns.

entries.title: Neonate
entries.content: A young Kindred, recently Embraced and released from their sire's tutelage.

entries.title: Papillon
entries.content: The red-light entertainment district of a city, prime hunting grounds where mortal disappearances go unnoticed.

entries.title: Praxis
entries.content: The right of Princes to govern and administer their domain, including formal edicts, courts, and policies.

entries.title: Progeny
entries.content: All of a given vampire's childer and descendants considered collectively.

entries.title: Regnant
entries.content: A Kindred who holds a mystical blood bond over another vampire or ghoul.

entries.title: Retainer
entries.content: A mortal servant bound by blood, hypnosis, or loyalty to serve a vampiric master.

entries.title: Siren
entries.content: A vampire who seduces prey to feed without violence, taking modest quantities to leave the victim alive.

entries.title: Suspire
entries.content: The grueling spiritual ordeal and epiphany experienced on the threshold of achieving Golconda.

entries.title: Third Mortal, The
entries.content: Caine, who slew Abel and was cursed by God to become the First Vampire.

entries.title: Thrall
entries.content: An individual bound by a three-step blood bond to obey a regnant's will.

entries.title: Vitae
entries.content: The mystical life-blood of a vampire that fuels Disciplines and supernatural existence.

entries.title: Whelp
entries.content: A derogatory term for an inexperienced young Kindred, originally referring to one's own disappointing childer.

entries.title: Whig
entries.content: An elder's contemptuous term for a vampire who displays an unbecoming fascination with modern mortal trends.

entries.title: Wight
entries.content: A mortal human; also used for a vampire whose Humanity has dropped to zero, fully consumed by the Beast.

entries.title: Witch-Hunter
entries.content: A dedicated mortal inquisitor or hunter sworn to expose and destroy the undead.

entries.title: Alleycat
entries.content: A nomadic vampire who keeps no permanent haven, sleeping rough and feeding on the homeless.

entries.title: Banking
entries.content: The practice of stealing or purchasing refrigerated blood from blood banks or hospitals. Kindred who do this are called Bankers.

entries.title: Black Hand (Slang)
entries.content: A common Camarilla street misconception that refers to the Sabbat as a whole, rather than its elite internal militia.

entries.title: Blister
entries.content: A vampiric carrier who contracts human disease and spreads it indiscriminately across victims.

entries.title: Blood Doll
entries.content: A mortal groupie who willingly offers their veins to vampires for the euphoric high of the Kiss.

entries.title: Bloodline
entries.content: A lineage of vampires descended from a Clan that possesses distinct Disciplines or flaws without an Antediluvian founder.

entries.title: Butterfly
entries.content: A vampire who socializes exclusively among high-society elites, celebrities, and politicians to feed.

entries.title: Casanova
entries.content: A vampire who seduces mortals to feed peacefully, wiping their memories through Dominate or Presence.

entries.title: Change, The
entries.content: Street slang for the traumatic transformation of the Embrace.

entries.title: Damned, The
entries.content: All vampires; the undead race.

entries.title: Donor
entries.content: Sarcastic street slang for a human victim or feeding target.

entries.title: Farmer
entries.content: A term of derision for vampires who refuse to hunt humans and feed only on livestock or wild animals.

entries.title: Fief
entries.content: A sarcastic slang term for a Prince's claimed territory or domain.

entries.title: Head
entries.content: A vampire who feeds on drunk or high mortals to get a second-hand buzz (pothead, juicehead, smackhead).

entries.title: Headhunter
entries.content: A predatory vampire who tracks and feeds upon other Kindred.

entries.title: Juicebag / Juice Box
entries.content: Cynical street slang for mortals, reducing them to portable blood containers.

entries.title: Lick
entries.content: Common street slang for a vampire; a fellow member of the undead.

entries.title: Rack, The
entries.content: The city's prime nightlife strip (clubs, dive bars, party districts) where hunting is easy and discrete.

entries.title: Rake
entries.content: A habitual club-hopper who prowls the Rack every night to hunt.

entries.title: Sandman
entries.content: A vampire who stalks and feeds on sleeping mortals in their beds.

entries.title: Slumming
entries.content: Feeding on transients, vagrants, and the destitute in back alleys. Those who do so are Slummers.

entries.title: Stalker
entries.content: Neonate slang for a mortal vampire hunter or private investigator digging into Kindred affairs.

entries.title: Tease
entries.content: Street slang for a female Casanova who uses flirtation to lure prey.

entries.title: Turf
entries.content: A gang or coterie's claimed hunting perimeter or city blocks.

entries.title: Vegetary
entries.content: Sarcastic slang for a vampire living strictly on animal blood (synonymous with Farmer).

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Baron
entries.content: An Anarch leader who exercises sway over an established domain, borough, or neighborhood through charisma, respect, or force (e.g., MacNeil, Abrams, Voerman, Nines Rodriguez).

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Chancellor
entries.content: An elected executive in an Anarch commune, overseeing municipal administration and community consensus.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Compact
entries.content: A mutual-defense agreement or civic fraternity where members stand collective surety for one another. Also called krew, posse, or frankpledge.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Free State
entries.content: The Anarch Free State, established in California following the 1944 uprising against Don Sebastian; also used generally for any independent Anarch territory lacking a Prince.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: La Libertad
entries.content: An Anarch domain's anniversary celebration, held throughout California on Cinco de Mayo, featuring the swearing-in of new citizens and civic rallies.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Legate
entries.content: An envoy, diplomat, or undercover strongarm dispatched between baronies to negotiate alliances or conduct reconnaissance (derisively called Cheka).

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Libertas
entries.content: The foundational principle of the Status Perfectus declaring that free will is an inherent spiritual right of all Kindred.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Molotow
entries.content: A traveling provocateur or insurgent-for-hire employed by Anarch domains to harass Camarilla borders while maintaining plausible deniability.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Old Volunteer
entries.content: A veteran who distinguished themselves in the historic Anarch revolts (such as the 1944 Los Angeles revolt) and commands deep generational respect.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: President
entries.content: Head of the executive branch in democratic Anarch domains practicing separation of powers.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Reeve
entries.content: An Anarch domain's head of law enforcement, equivalent to a Camarilla Sheriff but subordinate to popular consent and community warrants.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Rule of Law
entries.content: The core tenet that even Barons and revolutionary leaders are strictly subordinate to the laws agreed upon by popular consent.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Status Perfectus
entries.content: The seminal 1944 revolutionary manifesto drafted by the Los Angeles Revolutionary Council declaring a Kindred society free of elder tyranny and clan prejudice.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Sweeper
entries.content: A scout charged with scouring a barony to register new arrivals, identify unaligned neonates, and watch for Camarilla or Sabbat infiltrators.

entries.section: Anarch Free State & Los Angeles Terms
entries.title: Warlord
entries.content: A tactical military commander elected during active war or siege with rival Sects (often designated 'Red Chief' alongside peacetime 'White Chiefs').

entries.title: Archbishop
entries.content: The supreme ruler and spiritual commander of a Sabbat city or diocese, commanding all local packs.

entries.title: Auctoritas Ritae
entries.content: The 13 sacred, universal rituals practiced by all Sabbat members to maintain sect unity, purge fear, and renew loyalty to the Sword of Caine.

entries.title: Bishop
entries.content: A high-ranking Sabbat officer assisting the Archbishop, typically overseeing a designated precinct or operational branch of the crusade.

entries.title: Code of Milan
entries.content: The constitutional treaty of the Sabbat establishing pack autonomy, the right to call councils, the rite of Monomacy, and mutual defense against Antediluvians.

entries.title: Creation Rites
entries.content: The harrowing trial and test of fire through which a fledgling must survive to be formally recognized as True Sabbat.

entries.title: Ductus
entries.content: The operational and tactical leader of an individual Sabbat pack, directing combat, haven security, and mission logistics.

entries.title: Ignoblis Ritae
entries.content: Spontaneous or localized pack rituals created to build camaraderie, celebrate kills, or test bravery (such as the Fire Dance).

entries.title: Loyalist
entries.content: A member of the rebellious Sabbat faction claiming that each Cainite is their own master, resisting central decrees in the name of absolute freedom.

entries.title: Monomacy
entries.content: The sacred ritus of combat to the death used by Sabbat members to settle disputes of honor or challenge officers for leadership.

entries.title: Pack
entries.content: The fundamental family and combat unit of the Sabbat, bound together by the Vinculum and shared survival.

entries.title: Pack Priest
entries.content: The spiritual leader of a Sabbat pack responsible for conducting ritae, presiding over the Vaulderie, and guiding packmates on their Paths of Enlightenment.

entries.title: Priscus
entries.content: A venerable elder and advisor to the Sabbat Regent or Archbishop, prized for age and cunning (plural: Prisci).

entries.title: Shovelhead
entries.content: A mortal hastily Embraced, hit with a shovel, and buried alive in mass graves during wartime assaults to forge feral frontline cannon fodder.

entries.title: Ultra-Conservative
entries.content: The faction of ancient Sabbat elders who advocate strict military discipline and centralization to win the war of Gehenna.

entries.title: Vaulderie
entries.content: The core ritual of the Sabbat in which pack members commingle their vitae in a sacred chalice and drink together, forging the Vinculum.

entries.title: Vinculum
entries.content: The mystical loyalty bond formed between members of a pack through the Vaulderie, shattering existing blood bonds and replacing them with pack solidarity.

entries.title: Akhu
entries.content: The classical school of Setite blood sorcery drawn from the ancient religious and funeral rites of pharaonic Egypt.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Apprentice
entries.content: The lowest rank in the Tremere hierarchy, ranging from newly Embraced fledglings to veteran researchers bound to their chantry.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Ashipu
entries.content: A practitioner of Dur-An-Ki, traditionally an Assamite sorcerer adhering to the Mesopotamian mystical covenants.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Chantry
entries.content: A protected redoubt and laboratory where Tremere gather to guard secrets, conduct Thaumaturgical research, and commune with the Pyramid.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Council of Seven
entries.content: The seven highest-ranking Tremere Methuselahs, each directing Clan operations across an entire global hemisphere under Tremere himself.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Diabolist / Demonologist
entries.content: An infernalist who summons, bargains with, or studies demonic entities in exchange for dark investments.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Dur-An-Ki
entries.content: Ancient blood magic originating in Mesopotamia, practiced by Banu Haqim sorcerers channeling celestial covenants and planetary deities.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Houngan
entries.content: A priest in Afro-Caribbean Voudoun traditions, applicable in the context of both Wanga and Voudoun Necromancy.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Nahuallotl
entries.content: The Mesoamerican blood sorcery practiced primarily by the Tlacique bloodline, rooted in heart sacrifices and solar renewal.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Necromancer
entries.content: A generic descriptor for any practitioner of Necromancy, the art of manipulating corpses, spirits, and the energies of the Underworld.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 16

entries.title: Pyramid, The
entries.content: The worldwide, rigidly disciplined hierarchy that controls all Tremere chantries, councils, and apprentices across the globe.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 17

entries.title: Regent
entries.content: The middle management of Clan Tremere who oversees a regional chantry, monitors apprentices, and enforces Clan policy.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 17

entries.title: Sadhana
entries.content: The Indian school of blood sorcery drawn from Vedic beliefs and ascetic disciplines, practiced by the Daitya bloodline.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 17

entries.title: Thaumaturge
entries.content: A generic term for a Kindred practicing blood magic, originating from Hermetic traditions and popularized by the Camarilla.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 17

entries.title: Voudoun
entries.content: A religion and spiritual framework integrated with Necromancy and Wanga, popular among Caribbean and Louisiana Kindred.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 17

entries.title: Wanga
entries.content: A diverse collection of magical practices and curse-craft stemming from Caribbean slave communities and spirit pacts.
entries.source: V20 Rites of the Blood, p. 17

entries.title: 1944 Anarch Free State Revolt & Fall of Don Sebastian
entries.content: In 1944, Brujah revolutionary Jeremy MacNeil led a ferocious armed rebellion against Los Angeles' tyrannical Camarilla Prince, Don Sebastian Juan Dominguez, after Sebastian ordered MacNeil beaten for minor insolence. The ensuing popular uprising purged the Camarilla court from the basin, drove Sebastian to his Final Death, and permanently established Los Angeles as the global capital of the Anarch Free State.
entries.source: V20 Anarchs Unbound, p. 8; Campaign Lore

entries.title: Battle of the Memorial Coliseum
entries.content: A massive psychic and social clash staged during an NFL game between the LA Rams and SF 49ers at Exposition Park. With over 70,000 mortals acting as an emotional furnace, Anarch figures Jeremy MacNeil, Smiling Jack, and Misty Vane rallied crowd frenzy to sharpen revolutionary fervor. The spectacle drew a tense confrontation with Archon Theo Bell, revealing deep fractures between Anarch factions and Camarilla overseers.

entries.title: Burbank Airport Private Hangar Summit
entries.content: A secretive, high-level debriefing conducted inside a private executive hangar at Burbank Airport. Archon Theo Bell and Prince Meredith Vereira confronted the coterie following the Lynn Ranch Sabbat raid and the daylight sniper murder of Jade Nguyen.
